name: Markdown-it markdown parser
description: This script replaces the default markdown renderer with markdown-it and allows for optional LaTeX rendering support with the Markdown-It KaTeX plugin. (NOTE: LaTeX defaults to rendering with MathML ONLY). Dependencies markdown-it.js (v8.4.2 bundled with the script) Markdown-It KaTeX plugin (v0.18.0 bundled with the script) Usage For the possible configuration options check here.
